description: Token safety check for AI agents before they swap: quote-based sellability, round-trip cost, TRUST / CAUTION / AVOID. $0.02 per call, free pre-signing gate included. Returns evidence: live contract facts, market liquidity, a USD-sized sell QUOTED through the configured venues' own routers (direct and WETH-routed), round-trip cost at your intended size, and phantom-price detection. It does NOT execute or simulate a transfer: transfer tax, blacklist, pause, and max-tx restrictions are listed in notChecked, not tested. Unconfigured venues are also named in notChecked; this is not a honeypot proof.

chainId.description: REQUIRED. 1 Ethereum, 42161 Arbitrum, 8453 Base. There is no default; omitting it returns 400 missing_chain.

intendedUsd.description: Size the agent plans to buy, in USD (default 500)

offeredPriceUsd.description: Optional price per token someone offered you

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 contract address, or a known symbol like WETH

name: check_token_safety
